description: Andhra Pradesh AI skills plan targets 50 lakh learners, with AI lessons from Class 6, eight degree credits and SWAYAM Plus courses for students and youth.
body_lead: Andhra Pradesh AI skills training is set to reach 50 lakh students and young people under a plan drawn up by the state’s Education Department, as reported on 7 November 2026. AI lessons will enter the Class 6 syllabus, degree students will earn eight credits for AI, and teachers will be trained first. The figure is Andhra Pradesh’s share of the Centre’s goal of building one crore AI-skilled people across India, according to ETV Bharat’s report on the state action plan.
